01

Initial assignment

Choose what happens when a new lead arrives.

Select one or more users (Command/Ctrl-click). Assignment follows the displayed order, from top to bottom, then repeats.

Reassignment permissions

03

Automatic lead recycling

Reassign leads that remain in a stage beyond its time limit.

Pending Claimdays
Give a new owner the opportunity to accept this lead.
Claimeddays
Recycle when the lead has not moved to the next stage.
Recycle in the listed user order for the selected role, skipping the current owner. If the result is still the current owner, mark Disqualified and retain read-only in All leads only. Qualified leads are excluded in this demo.
Initial assignment changes apply to new leads. Recycling thresholds apply when a lead reaches its configured stage limit. Reassignment restarts the recycling clock. A regular user’s first follow-up claims a shared lead; the business stage does not change.
